;*******************************************************************************************************************************
;** Coverage: display rounding under DRM of a long integer too wide for its line. DLX checks the X line, DLA the text a long  **
;** integer appends to a string (Y string + X long integer, longIntegerToDisplayString), each reduced to sign, digits and     **
;** exponent. The X line keeps the grouped integer while it fits (21 digits with the separator, 24 with NONE) and shows a     **
;** wider one as a real: 16 digits, 15 when negative, one fewer from exponent 100, the exact integer rounded once under DRM.  **
;** The appended text cuts whole groups and rounds the kept digits from the dropped text and the remainder of its division    **
;** by 10^shift, with the left separator on or NONE. DRM 0 to 6; 20 to 400 digits; the six points of drm_round_cov at the     **
;** digit the line keeps, plus all nines; each positive and negative; separator on and NONE. Expected: Python decimal from    **
;** the rules in probe/gen_drm_longint_cov.py, not from a build.                                                              **
;*******************************************************************************************************************************
